scope: Read-only source inspection; no emulator, host input, desktop or project source mutation. No product promotion.

limits: Z80 command table excludes breakpoint/step/watchpoint under NEW_CORE. Inspect actual pinned binary capability before accepting requests.
CPU logical address and bank identity must be explicit.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Versioned allowlist: breakpoint/advance/step/next; bound command count, stop reason, wall timeout and hit count.

limits: Z80 handler instruments WRITE_8 memory, not memory reads nor I/O port writes.
Readable mapped chunks set check_change: an unchanged byte write does not hit. This is not a record of every write attempt.
Address and size reach uint16_t parameters; reject zero size, truncation, overflow and ranges crossing 0xFFFF. Max individually representable size is 65535.
Range check_change is derived from the first mapped chunk; require a coherent range/mapping, not an arbitrary cross-map range.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Use changed-RAM-byte fixtures for positive and unchanged-write/read/OUT negative cases. Preserve old/new address, PC and cycles as observed, without claiming a bus trace.

limits: Do not label write/change watchpoints read/access watches.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Reject unsupported modes explicitly; use Emulicious capability-qualified path if required.

limits: Shared reg_hook exists but callback casts system to genesis_context and finds M68K root. It is not safe to transplant into SMS.
Existing hook ignores same-value register writes.
SMS commands expose vdpsprites/vdpregs, not vdpregbreak.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Reject as unavailable on current SMS backend. A new SMS-aware adapter/hook needs its own fixture and code review; never cast SMS as Genesis.

limits: Source search of debug.c and vdp.c found no dedicated native SMS VRAM event watchpoint command.
vdp:vram array access/save is a snapshot and can expose mutable array elements; it is not an event watchpoint.
A CPU memory watchpoint does not watch SMS OUT writes to VDP ports.
The broad changelog wording cannot establish platform-specific availability.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Keep unsupported/requires_adapter, or use bounded snapshots and describe only endpoint changes. No claim to catch transient writes.

limits: Commands/functions/conditions/if/while/variables/arrays/save/load and bindings are not an automatic safe protocol.
while/function recursion can hang; set/load/array setters mutate ROM state.
frames N requests a future debugger entry, and a breakpoint/watchpoint can stop earlier; prompt arrival alone does not prove N frames advanced.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Separate bounded observation from explicit mutation; allowlist schema and state snapshots; require actual frame/cycle deltas and stop reason; reject unrestricted scripts by default.

limits: APNG writing is inside render_gl main framebuffer path and compiled with zlib; SDL fallback or DISABLE_ZLIB cannot be silently treated as APNG success.
Animation duration uses nominal PAL50/NTSC60 with source TODO more precise rate. It does not prove real-time throughput or exact SMS NTSC timing.
Canvas follows overscan configuration, not an unconditional 256x192.
Explicitly toggle stop and check finalized animation, full frame count, dimensions, frame delays and content; file existence alone is inadequate.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Use private process-local bindup ui.record_video; hash config, assert GL/zlib, close recording before cleanup, audit decoded frames with the cumulative timeline.

limits: ui.record_video starts/stops both APNG and WAVE. No independent WAVE debugger command identified.
Header is sample_rate,16-bit,2-channel; capture follows audio mixing callbacks, not exact VDP command boundaries.
Silent/short/truncated WAVE remains possible and must fail the appropriate gate. Dummy output isolation is not proof of correct capture alignment.
sms.c cassette WAVE input is a separate feature and not output recording.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Finalize then audit RIFF lengths, sample rate, channels, duration, peak/RMS, signal identity and bounded alignment; preserve audio not_run when not collected.

limits: Plane viewer alternates plane/sprite via debug_modes; no independent ui.sprite_debug binding identified.
ui.vdp_debug_mode changes the active auxiliary framebuffer only: selection requires private window identity/focus or a qualified direct adapter.
Auxiliary planes are not the main-game 256x192 framebuffer and do not prove rendered SAT order/flicker/game quality.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Capture named private auxiliary window/framebuffer with role, dimensions, mode and ROM/session identity; never use host focus or claim game visual approval.

limits: Mode4 render/dispatch is present; output fidelity has not been exercised in this review.
Viewer canvases include 1024x512 VRAM,512x512 CRAM and LINEBUF_SIZE composition; they are diagnostic presentations.
Internal CRAM arrays and physical SMS palette presentation have different indexing/size contracts. Do not treat internal64-byte dumps as64 physical SMS colors.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Use distinct artifact roles and hardware-specific array bounds/normalization; validate with known Mode4 fixture before feature qualification.

limits: PSGscope visualizes waveforms, not an audio fidelity or music-quality verdict.
Private auxiliary window still needs ownership/capture identity.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Optional diagnostic artifact, separately from WAVE and musical-quality review.

limits: GDB handler takes m68k_context and Z2 calls m68k_add_watchpoint. It is not a Z80GDB implementation.
Z3 read/Z4 access return unsupported.
Global CLI -D selection is not evidence of working SMS transport.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Reject SMS GDB requests explicitly; prefer the native Z80 debugger backend. Do not advertise GDBZ2 as SMS capability.

limits: 1.0.0 lists Z80 IN(C) and Sega mapper-state fixes potentially relevant to SMS, but no affected SMS fixture was run here.
YM2612/M68K/DMA fixes do not become SMS improvements.
No later release or current maintenance status verified; no external release lookup performed.
feature_matrix.integration_recommendation: Releases require manual source/archive/binary hashes, capability manifest and focused positive/negative plus ROM baselines before changing default. Preserve old evidence with its original binary pin.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: Capability belongs to a platform, CPU core and build configuration, not to an emulator marketing list.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Per-feature applicability and unsupported-mode negatives; source/binary hash pins.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: Distinguish changed-byte memory watches from every-write, read/access and I/O/VDP events.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Changed write hits, identical write/read/OUT do not satisfy the changed-byte fixture; coherent range bounds enforced.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: A programmable debugger needs bounded stop reasons and separate observational/mutating modes.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Reject arbitrary scripts; enforce command/hit/wall limits; verify frame/cycle boundaries after early stops.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: APNG nominal delays do not measure throughput, ROM logic FPS or exact NTSC cadence.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Decode complete frame sequence, verify dimensions/delays and keep throughput claim false without independent measurement.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: A WAVE filename does not prove duration, alignment, correct signal or host isolation.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Finalize, RIFF-size/actualduration/signal checks and explicit timeline/tail/alignment contract.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: Auxiliary viewer evidence must keep its own role, mode and private window identity.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: Reject diagnostic viewer images promoted to main framebuffer/game quality; never select host desktop by title.

lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.lesson: Maintenance upgrades preserve versioned evidence and require new platform-specific qualification.
lesson_candidates_no_canonical_ids_assig.measurable_gate: New archive/binary/source pins with capability and negative regression reports; no inherited current-build approval.

claim_ceiling: Platform-scoped source implementation/path findings. No assertion of current wrapper integration, actual binary availability, runtime accuracy, throughput, audio correctness or game quality.
